cards.name: Assassino
cards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished vertical character card for the social deduction game Cidade Dorme. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, straight-on flat card artwork filling the entire image, NOT a photograph of a physical card. Elegant dark fantasy, premium illustrated card game, detailed painterly realism. Established game's identity: midnight navy #07131f, slate blue #294257, antique champagne gold #e7c997, ivory #f5f0e8. Moonlit old European lakeside village, stone buildings, distant rooftops, soft fog and warm amber windows. Refined narrow antique gold double-line border inset 4%, restrained ornamental corners and tiny crescent centered at the top. Rich subtle paper and painted texture, cinematic cool moonlight and restrained warm rim light. Single character centered, shown from knees upward, face and silhouette readable on a phone. Unified card layout: illustration occupies upper 85%, lower 15% fades seamlessly into deep navy with the character name centered in large elegant antique-gold serif lettering, no separate UI panels. Only the exact character name as text, no title Cidade Dorme, no subtitles, rules, numbers, watermarks, logos, other writing. No gore. Full bleed rectangular canvas, no external background or drop shadow.
Subject: A stealthy hooded assassin in a dark weathered cloak, lower face subtly concealed, watchful eyes in shadow, a discreet clean dagger held low. Dangerous, mysterious, quietly threatening, poised in a narrow moonlit alley. No blood.
Text (verbatim): "Assassino".
